# Roadmap

**Measure → Recommend → Automate**, then make it sellable. Each phase builds on the previous one without reworking the
foundation. The numbered phases below follow the owner's order in [`docs/product/08-phases.md`](docs/product/08-phases.md).

## Direction (hand-written)

What is open, in the order it is likely to be taken. Items move into `CHANGELOG.md` when they ship.

### Next

| Status | Item | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Planned | **Verify the methodology** against Cloud Carbon Footprint and the clouds' own reports; publish the result on the Methodology page | the figures are provisional until a third party can check them; deliberately deferred until external conditions exist |
| Planned | **Embodied emissions (SCI's M)** per instance family | operational-only is the largest known gap in every figure and in the GHG report |
| Planned | **Alerts and e-mail name the cloud** a budget belongs to | budgets became per-cloud in alpha.175; their alert text does not say which |
| Planned | **DigitalOcean connector** (billing API / invoices) | the interface, colours and switches already handle a fourth cloud |
| Planned | **Teams** destination and the Terraform provider in the public registry | phase 5 leftovers |
| Active | **Grid data with history**: ENTSO-E token is in (Europe works); an Electricity Maps plan or WattTime account for regions the free sources do not cover | the daily request budget of the current plan is used up |

### Later

| Status | Item |
|---|---|
| Planned | Terraform and Kubernetes **executors** with dry-run, idempotency keys and locks, behind separately granted credentials |
| Planned | Percentile-based Kubernetes rightsizing and **reading existing commitments** for Azure and Google Cloud |
| Planned | Market-based accounting, water use, per-instance power models |
| Planned | SAML/OIDC enforcement per organization (identity-provider side), public pricing and external documentation (phase 6) |
| Planned | Shared read cache between API replicas, a leader-elected scheduler, read replicas |
| Planned | Service extraction **only** when a measured trigger fires ([ADR-0005](docs/adr/0005-service-extraction-triggers.md)); candidates are listed in [the architecture description](docs/architecture/platform-full.uk.md#10-мікросервіси-і-майбутнє) |

## Guiding rules

1. **No guessing.** Missing data is shown as missing; estimates are labelled with their method and confidence.
2. **Nothing changes production without a human decision** and an audit record.
3. **Security by construction:** isolation in the database, secrets never stored in the application database, least privilege everywhere.
4. **Extract a service only when a measured trigger fires** ([ADR-0005](docs/adr/0005-service-extraction-triggers.md)).
5. **Clouds are never added together across currencies** ([ADR-0065](docs/adr/0065-cloud-scope.md)).

Product specification and the current gap list: [`docs/product/`](docs/product/README.md).
